1.prompt:
A waist-up photograph of <<<8a33b9d3-bcfd-43c5-b4c6-c9fba5b194b4>>>, a 24-year-old Chinese-Malaysian woman in Kuala Lumpur, sitting sideways on an upturned crate in her own garage late at night, her body turned about thirty degrees away from the lens and her head turned back toward it.

Her build: an emphatic hourglass — a full high bust, a very narrow waist that curves sharply in, and full rounded hips, slim everywhere else. She is 166cm and 49kg. Fair, luminous porcelain skin (NOT tanned, NOT bronzed, NOT olive, NOT deep golden), visible skin pores, subtle natural skin texture, unretouched skin detail.

Her hair is a deep wine-red worn long and loosely waved with a lot of volume, a few silver-grey highlighted strands running through it. Both eyebrows and her whole jawline are visible.

She wears a fitted black ribbed tank top and high-waisted dark jeans, with an oil-marked work shirt worn open over the top like a jacket, both sleeves rolled to the elbow.

Her own garage at night: the bonnet of her car propped open beside her, a socket set spread on a rag, a coiled air hose, a wheel leaning against the wall, damp concrete floor.

One work lamp hooked under the open bonnet is the only light in the garage, an ordinary phone exposure, the rest of the garage dark.

She is wiping her hands on a cloth and has just looked up at the lens, a short unguarded laugh, thick brows and winged eyeliner.

The only person anywhere in this photograph is her — no one else in the frame, no one in any doorway, no hand or arm belonging to anybody else, no figure in any mirror or window reflection, no portrait or photograph of a person on any wall or screen. Every visible hand connects to one of her own arms.

Shot on a rear phone camera from about two metres away, crisp sharp focus on her face, natural colour grading.
1.note: 車庫夜燈、開引擎蓋、工具攤在地上、擦手布。臉與 master 一致，酒紅＋銀灰挑染完全執行。覆蓋度偏差：工作襯衫被綁在腰上而不是當外套穿，短版背心露腰——與跨人設既有發現同向（一律往「更少覆蓋」偏）。畫面本身可直接發布。
